spotlight.label: 04 — The system
spotlight.title: One mirror. A complete gym.
spotlight.defaultDescription: A 43-inch touchscreen mirror with digital motor resistance, AI motion analysis and hundreds of guided workouts. Designed to blend into your interior — and come alive the moment you start.

hotspots.title: Digital motor

tech.label: 06 — Technology
tech.title: Designed around your body.
tech.intro: Five technologies, one purpose: making every session smarter, safer and more personal.

items.title: AI coach with motion tracking
items.text: A camera and smart software read your movement in real time. You get instant feedback on posture, range and tempo — as if a trainer were standing beside you.

items.title: Digital resistance up to 120 kg
items.text: An electric motor replaces the weight rack. Fine-tune resistance in small increments so every set is exactly heavy enough.

items.title: Five training modes
items.text: Standard, eccentric, elastic, constant speed and more. One device, five ways to challenge your muscles.

items.title: 43" immersive mirror
items.text: See yourself and your coach side by side, life-size. Switched off, it is simply a beautiful mirror.

items.title: Compact and silent
items.text: No plates, no clatter. imbody fits against any wall and takes up barely more space than a cabinet.

items.question: How much space do I need for imbody?
items.answer: Allow about 1.4 m² of floor space and a solid wall or the matching stand. During the demo we are happy to measure your room together.

items.question: Do I need a subscription?
items.answer: No. imbody works without a mandatory subscription. If you want extra programmes or content, that is entirely your choice.

items.question: Is imbody suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Absolutely. Resistance starts low and the AI coach adapts tempo and load to your level, so you build up safely and with confidence.

items.question: How do delivery and installation work?
items.answer: Our own team delivers imbody free of charge in the Netherlands and Belgium, assembles it and walks you through everything. You can start training right away.

items.question: What about my privacy?
items.answer: The camera is only used for motion analysis while you train. You decide which data you share.

steps.title: Local government

steps.title: National government
